stage: S5 the whole final verifier as one garbled circuit, evaluated on a Shinigami proof
engine: repository half-gates engine (garbled-snark-verifier, AesCcrGateHasher), streaming garble and evaluate modes

engine_changes.src/circuit/component_meta.rs: checked addition on the 16-bit credit counter (was an unchecked += that wraps in release builds)

construction.pieces: 1178 pieces of at most 1000 constraints plus one combining AND chain
construction.input_labels: keyed BLAKE3 of (global variable, bit); one pair per raw input bit across all pieces
construction.commitment: BLAKE3 over the per-piece BLAKE3 ciphertext hashes in piece order, the combining piece last

environment: WSL Ubuntu-24.04 on the laptop, 16 worker threads, RUSTFLAGS -C target-cpu=native
per_piece_checks: ciphertext count equals the non-free gate count of the engine and the direct AND count
the evaluator consumes exactly the ciphertexts of the piece
evaluated verdict equals the direct verdict
active output label equals the garbler label for the verdict and differs from the other label

fanout.first_attempt: 2000-constraint pieces failed inside the engine: created but not initialized

not_established: Bitcoin script, transactions or a dispute game
oblivious transfer or on-chain commitments for input labels
correctness of the garbling toward a second party (no cut-and-choose, no verifiable garbling)
the statement as an input rather than a circuit constant
a reviewed parameter set (the statement is the laboratory profile L21 of S4e)
